title: Jubilant Ukrainian Apricot Bowl
description: A cultured, silky hangover cure featuring dried apricots, spherified cucumber pearls, and a low-sodium dressing.
instructions: Soak the dried apricots in warm water for 30 minutes, then pat them dry.
Blend the coconut yogurt and maple syrup until silky smooth.
Peel the cucumber and grate it finely to create a pulp for spherification.
Dissolve 1 tsp sodium alginate in 500ml water and stir until fully dissolved.
Add the cucumber pulp to the alginate solution and mix gently to avoid bubbles.
Prepare a calcium bath by dissolving 1 tsp calcium chloride in 500ml water.
Drop small spoonfuls of the cucumber-pulp mixture into the calcium bath, allowing them to set into pearls for 2 minutes.
Drain the pearls and rinse them in cold water, then set aside.
Combine the apricots, yogurt mixture, lemon juice, dill, and mint in the earthenware bowl.
Fold in the spherified cucumber pearls and toasted pistachios gently.
Serve the bowl chilled, garnishing with extra mint and pistachios as desired.
